'''Arantza Urkaregi''' (born 23 April 1954) is a [[mathematician]], [[Trade union|union]] organizer, and [[Feminism|feminist]] politician. Within mathematics, she writes, researches, and teaches predominantly about [[statistics]].<ref name=":1">{{Cite web|title=Arantza Urkaregi Etxepare :: Inguma - Euskal komunitate zientifikoaren datu-basea|url=http://www.inguma.eus/egilea/ikusi/arantza-urkaregi-etxepare|access-date=2021-12-06|website=www.inguma.eus}}</ref> With regards to her political work, she was involved in the [[Communism|communist]] party in [[Basque Country (autonomous community)|Basque]] and the early feminist movement there.<ref name=":0">{{Cite web|title=|url=https://www.berria.eus/hemeroteka/egunkaria/pdfa/?data=2002-12-15&orria=069&zenb=K1NNdDZHRklPY0Ftd3pRNHFlNkxYdz09}}</ref>

== Life ==
Urkaregi was born on 23 April 1954 in [[San Sebastián|San Sebastian]], in the Basque Autonomous community in Spain. She studied at the [[University of the Basque Country|University of Basque Country]].{{cn|date=December 2021}}

== Activist work ==
In her 20s, she became involved in EMK (the Basque communist party) and Basque feminist organizations.<ref name=":0" /> For example, she was largely involved in the first meetings of the Basque feminist movement in December 1977. While these meetings fit into the broader theme of [[Second-wave feminism|feminist movements in the 60s and 70s]], they are especially important because of the particular anti-feminist pushback in Basque. These meetings in December 1977 were actually inspired by similar Spanish feminist meetings. Overall, these meetings, which had attendance far exceeding expectations, were key in demonstrating the existence of, and support for, a Basque feminist movement.<ref name=":0" />

[[File:Arantza urkaregi 0001.jpg|thumb|Urkaregi talking to the press]]
Urkaregi has also been deeply involved in a Basque teachers union (Steilas), which recently (in 2020) went on strike in protest of insufficient support for teaching in the midst of COVID-19.<ref>{{Cite web|last=Belaud|first=Victor|title=Basque Country: thousands of education workers strike for a safe return to school and quality education for all students|url=https://www.csee-etuce.org/en/policy-issues/covid-19/294-latest-updates/3942-basque-country-thousands-of-education-workers-strike-for-a-safe-return-to-school-and-quality-education-for-all-students-2|access-date=2021-12-06|website=European Trade Union Committee for Education|language=en-gb}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|title=A strike in education in Basque Country, called for the 15th of September by all the trade unions|url=https://www.ela.eus/en/news/a-strike-in-education-in-basque-country-called-for-the-15th-of-september-by-all-the-trade-unions|access-date=2021-12-06|website=Plone site|language=en}}</ref>
She has also been on the Bilbao City Council as a member of the Abertzale Sozialistak group.<ref>{{Cite web|title=La participación de las mujeres en la actividad política|url=https://www.euskonews.eus/0119zbk/gaia11901es.html|access-date=2021-12-06|website=www.euskonews.eus}}</ref> Particularly, Urkaregi has been active in [[Basque separatist]] groups, such being the spokesperson for [[Basque Nationalist Action]], which was outlawed by the Spanish government in 2008 for supposed ties to [[ETA (separatist group)|ETA]].<ref>{{Cite web|title=Spanish Supreme Court outlaws Basque Nationalist Action|url=https://www.nationalia.info/new/8732/spanish-supreme-court-outlaws-basque-nationalist-action|access-date=2021-12-06|website=Nationalia|language=Catalan}}</ref> In 2009, she was arrested along with other members of the group.<ref>{{Cite web|title=Spokesperson for Basque banned political party Herria Aurrera, Arantxa Urkaregi, is led away from its headquarters by police during an operation directed by Spanish judge Baltasar Garzon in Bilbao January 23, 2009. Spanish police arrested eight leading members of Basque separatist groups on suspicion of having links to ETA rebels and searched 18 buildings in raids early on Friday, the Interior Ministry said. REUTERS/Vincent West (SPAIN Stock Photo - Alamy|url=https://www.alamy.com/spokesperson-for-basque-banned-political-party-herria-aurrera-arantxa-urkaregi-is-led-away-from-its-headquarters-by-police-during-an-operation-directed-by-spanish-judge-baltasar-garzon-in-bilbao-january-23-2009-spanish-police-arrested-eight-leading-members-of-basque-separatist-groups-on-suspicion-of-having-links-to-eta-rebels-and-searched-18-buildings-in-raids-early-on-friday-the-interior-ministry-said-reutersvincent-west-spain-image400052220.html|access-date=2021-12-06|website=www.alamy.com|language=en}}</ref>

== Academic work ==
As demonstrated by Inguma, which is a database for publications in the Basque scientific community, Urkaregi has published extensively about [[biostatistics]].<ref name=":1" /> There are over 50 publications attributed to her here, including a biostatistics textbook,<ref>{{Cite web|title=Bioestatistika: Oinarrizko Ikastaroa|url=https://ikasmaterialak.ehu.eus/matematika/bioestatistika-oinarrizko-ikastaroa|access-date=2021-12-06|website=UPV/EHUko ikasmaterialen sare-argitalpenak|language=eu}}</ref><ref>{{Cite book|last1=Etxepare|first1=Arantza Urkaregi|url=http://www.inguma.eus/produkzioa/ikusi/bioestatistika-oinarrizko-ikastaroa|title=Bioestatistika: oinarrizko ikastaroa|last2=Madariaga|first2=Inma Arostegi|date=2014|publisher=UPV/EHU arg|isbn=978-84-9860-930-1|language=eu-ES}}</ref> articles about feminism and math,<ref>{{Cite journal|last=Etxepare|first=Arantza Urkaregi|date=2010|title=Matematikak femeninoak al dira?|url=http://www.inguma.eus/produkzioa/ikusi/matematikak-femeninoak-al-dira|journal=EKAIA|language=eu-ES|issue=23|pages=89–98|issn=0214-9001}}</ref><ref>{{Cite journal|last1=Hernandorena|first1=Edurne Seijo|last2=Etxepare|first2=Arantza Urkaregi|date=1998|title=Emakume matematikariak, historian zehar|url=http://www.inguma.eus/produkzioa/ikusi/emakume-matematikariak-historian-zehar|language=eu-ES}}</ref> and courses.<ref>{{Cite journal|last1=Beraza|first1=Irantzu Barrio|last2=Uriarte|first2=Naiara Arrizabalaga|last3=Etxepare|first3=Arantza Urkaregi|last4=Zelaia|first4=Elisabete Alberdi|date=2013|title=Matematikari Euskaldunen I. Topaketak|url=http://www.inguma.eus/produkzioa/ikusi/matematikari-euskaldunen-i-topaketak|language=eu-ES}}</ref>
